title: FCH protocells from noise: bilayer vesicles that trap a solute their own membrane makes (SIBW, new class fch-bilayer)
summary: Functionalized Cahn-Hilliard amphiphile u (eta1=2.5, eta2=5.25, white-noise start at mean -1.3) plus a solute c that only the bilayer makes (kp (u+0.6)_+), that decays slowly everywhere (kd=0.001) and that the bilayer excludes through a barrier potential chi u (Scharfetter-Gummel flux, chi=6). On all three seeds five closed bilayer rings nucleate from noise by t~30 and the solute they release into their lumens stays there: lumen/outside contrast 16-41x for the whole run (t=80-800), against 1.1-1.2 by the end with chi=0, where contrast falls below 2 by t~80-160; at 1.5x resolution (dx 0.333) seven vesicles hold 16-36x. Limits: the solute is passive (the membrane does not feel it, osm=0, because the two-way coupling blew up explicitly), the eta terms are O(1) rather than asymptotically small, some nuclei grow into multilamellar onions with little lumen, a vesicle fusion on seed 1 released its contents, and nothing divides.

claims.statement: From white noise over the whole domain, closed bilayer vesicles (an amphiphile ring around a solvent lumen) nucleate and persist for the whole run on 3/3 seeds, and each holds the solute its own bilayer makes at 16-41x the outside concentration from formation to t=800; with the barrier removed (chi=0) the contrast is gone (1.1-1.2), and it survives a 1.5x finer grid (16-36x).
claims.track: seed 0, track #3 (pack/seed0/tracks.png): a vesicle from t~8 to t=800 with a cyan bilayer ring around a gold solute-filled lumen throughout

controls_run.W: pack_chi0/ (seeds 0 and 1: chi=0, the barrier ablated, everything else identical; contrast 1.10 and 1.19 at t=800, contrast.txt), pack_res15/ (1.5x resolution, 16-36x)
controls_run.B: pack_chi0/: without the barrier the lumen is no longer chemically distinct from the outside, while the bilayer ring (u rim/core 1.7-3.2, rim/outside 22-81 in pack/seed*/FACTS.md) is unchanged

claims.bd_control: not run; a Laplacian-only twin of a sixth-order conserved amphiphile flow is not defined here. The chi=0 ablation (pure diffusion of c through the bilayer) is the matched control for the barrier.
